column1: # TruffleHog findings and unread files, reviewed by hand. Read by tools/secret_scan.py; see docs/agents/secret-scan.md.
# detector<TAB>path<TAB>SHA-256 of the raw value (for "unreadable": the Git blob ID)<TAB>classification
# An entry covers only that detector, that exact path and that exact value (or blob). The classification of each value was
# checked by locating the value in its blob and reading the token around it (2026-11-07, TruffleHog 3.99.8, no verification).
# No entry is a credential. Never add a line without that check; never add a path-only or detector-only line.
